relations.myth: Horos establishes the boundary of the Pleroma
relations.note: Horos protects the aeons by separating the Fullness from deficiency.

relations.myth: Christ instructs the aeons after Sophia's crisis
relations.note: Christ teaches the aeons about the Father and their own origin.
Holy Spirit teaches the aeons repose, equality, unity, and thanksgiving.
All aeons contribute their finest qualities to produce Jesus as their common Fruit.

relations.myth: Demiurge learns of the upper Fullness
relations.note: The Demiurge initially remains ignorant of the Pleroma but is later instructed about a higher God.

relations.myth: Christ enters and unites with the Pleroma
relations.note: Christ leaves Sophia, enters the Pleroma, and unites with the All and Paraclete.

relations.myth: Logos divides and helps restore the aeons
relations.note: Logos overreaches toward the Father, produces deficient orders, then participates in restoration.
